text:
ana (PM): quick thread to scope the FinServ pilot. customer asked for a priced path that sits between Hosted and Dedicated: per-route soft reservations, peak-priority minutes, and a pilot SLA credit mechanism. can we document whats feasible and what needs Enterprise?
lina (Sales): theyre committed to a monthly spend but dont want reserved GPUs. must-have: predictable capacity for two high-traffic routes and a defined remedy if latency spikes.
todd (Pricing): rough product options: a) per-route soft buckets billed per minute, b) priority-minute add-on (consumed when route marked priority), c) surge windows sold in blocks. commercial: commit + usage premium.
omar (Eng): tech feasibility: we can implement route-scoped token buckets + priority queue in the runtime; true hard isolation requires Dedicated. also KV cache pinning per-route is possible but needs storage and eviction rules.
mike (Infra): infra note: billing meters for per-minute priority need a low-latency emitter to avoid billing lag. can wire to existing metrics pipeline but need quotas for cardinality.
rachel (Legal): if we include SLA credits we must define measurement window, cap on credits, and exclusions. customer mentioned EU data residency toowe need an addendum.
ana (PM): typo, correction: ana (PM): propose we run a 4-week field pilot called "priority-reserve beta" with guardrails: - route-level soft reservations (QPS buckets) - priority-minute billing, tracked per-route - automatic fallback to baseline model variant when capacity is hit - SLA credit formula: minutes where p99 > target * credit unit. please react with concerns.
lina (Sales): sales approves pilot. FinServ is ok with non-binding SLA for pilot as long as SLOs are explicit and measurable.
todd (Pricing): +1. provide me a baseline unit-econ: expected priority token consumption, cost delta, uplift %. also recommend a fail-safe: per-customer monthly cap on priority spend.
omar (Eng): engineering acceptance criteria: 1) runtime supports priority flag and per-route token bucket, 2) KV pinning MVP (pin by prefix) with clear memory limits, 3) feature-flag rollout and canary. estimate 2 sprint spike + 3 sprints to pilot.
mike (Infra): infra acceptance: billing emitter for priority-minutes, metric tags for route and priority_level, alert if emitter backlog > 1k events.
rachel (Legal): legal asks: cap credits at monthly commit or 25% (whichever lower), include force majeure and maintenance windows, and EU data residency addendum. I'll draft contract language.
nana (PM): again small typo ana (PM): provisional pricing bands (todd please confirm): - priority-minute uplift: +15% on token rate - surge window (exclusive capacity): +35% and reserved block pricing - per-route soft bucket fee: small fixed monthly per route. these are placeholders until cost delta from eng.
todd (Pricing): noted. will run a sensitivity with three scenarios: conservative (low usage), typical, and heavy. will propose numeric per-1000 priority-minutes rates.
lina (Sales): FinServ also wants route gating: only specific route_ids can consume priority. confirm we can gate and enforce at API level?
omar (Eng): yes, we can gate on route_id and API param. enforcement path: server-side check + token bucket. will return 403 if over-limit for that route.
nana (PM): rollout plan: alpha -> FinServ (single customer) for 4 weeks -> collect metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, priority-minute consumption, cost delta, support tickets -> decide GA.
todd (Pricing): GA go/no-go criteria suggestion: pilot revenue uplift >= 10% net of cost and p99 delta on baseline routes <= 20%. if thresholds not met, iterate.
rachel (Legal): note: any public SLA expansion needs a liability review and sign-off. for pilot, we'll use a limited pilot T&C.
nana (PM): acceptance checklist draft:
- product: API + console toggle for per-route priority
- eng: runtime priority queue, KV pinning, route gating
- infra/billing: priority-minute meter and emitter
- pricing: economic model and pricing bands
- legal: pilot T&C + EU residency addendum
- sales: written pilot acceptance from FinServ
- observability: dashboard with token-level latency and cost per route
ops-bot: reminder set: "priority-reserve pilot kickoff" 2026-05-12 15:00 UTC
mike (Infra): I'll prototype the metric emitter in the spike.
todd (Pricing): I'll post a slide with scenario pricing by EOD Friday.
lina (Sales): I'll get the written acceptance from the customer today and share any constraints.
omar (Eng): will post design notes and perf expectations after spike (2w).
rachel (Legal): will circulate pilot clause draft in 3 business days.
nana (PM): action items consolidated:
- omar: spike + design doc for KV pinning + priority queue (2w)
- mike: metric emitter prototype + docs (2w)
- todd: pricing scenarios + unit-econ (5d)
- rachel: pilot T&C + EU addendum (3d)
- lina: acquire signed pilot acceptance (1d)
- ana: consolidate checklist and pilot dashboard mock (3d)
Thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after the spike. :thumbsup:
